content.overview: When drying departs from plan, the first task is not to invent a disposition. It is to preserve facts, identify connected material, stabilize the process within authority and hand unresolved decisions to the proper role.

vocabulary.definition: Material and process range plausibly connected to an event.
Temporary authorized action that limits risk while evaluation continues.
Transfer of identity, status, evidence gaps and responsibility to the next role or shift.

sections.title: Capture facts before cause claims
sections.body: Record timestamps, alarms, sensor status, room actions, lot locations and observations before drawing conclusions.

sections.title: Scope with genealogy and exposure
sections.body: Lot location, event duration, product measurements and stability knowledge help identify what may be affected without assuming either no impact or room-wide failure.

sections.title: Transfer unresolved status
sections.body: Written plus verbal handoff should identify holds, temporary controls, missing evidence and the next accountable role.

workedExamples: A fan interruption affects a mapped zone for a known duration; the response preserves that zone and its lots while qualified review evaluates consequence.
commonMistakes: Moving lots before preserving location history.
Treating restoration of equipment as proof that product is unaffected.
content.practicalApplication: Complete a drying deviation packet with timeline, equipment evidence, lot map, product observations, interim controls and decision owner.
content.summary: A strong drying response preserves evidence and scope so authorized disposition can follow defensible facts.
